method: Direct inspection of all twelve original native WPF client PNGs through local image viewing.

images.observation: Four compact track rows, real waveforms, Inspector automation entry, channel strips and transport fit in the client.
Source attachment, audition and export remain visible in the scrolling Inspector, with separate project-playback limitation. Shortcut help may require scrolling.
Horizontal scrolling moves the events while track headers and the ruler corner remain fixed.
Four normal-height rows fit with the Inspector and mixer retained.
Hiding side and lower panels expands the timeline and its row dividers to the available width.
Long project and event names truncate inside their cells while ordinary timing values remain visible.
The wider-window request remains constrained to the original observed client; no wider-desktop evidence is claimed.
Source identity, scrollable report, pagination and Cancel/Import controls fit in the captured client.
The changed-source message wraps beside complete Cancel/Import buttons at minimum size.
The volume curve, five-point list, exact fields, interpolation selector, point actions and history/Close footer fit at the minimum window size.
NaN remains visible in the draft value field; the finite-value validation message and footer remain fully visible.
Read is visibly off, stored points remain listed, the disabled Hold curve and dashed manual-value line are visible, and explanatory text states the manual playback value.

acceptance: No clipped required actions, validation messages, missing backgrounds or timeline alignment defects observed in the twelve exercised client states.
limitations: Client captures exclude the native operating-system frame.
Physical input, file dialogs and audio-device output remain unverified.
The source Inspector scrolls; not every help line fits at once.
The wider-window request remained constrained; no wider-screen validation.
This scoped editor and workflow acceptance does not establish full Windows parity or reference fidelity.
